summary: A nested counter with three long blocks: each visit of the left end turns one word 10111 of the right block into a 00111 and a 100 on the left (proved), then the 100-block is poured into a new right block at 2:1 (proved), and the left block is recycled as the next right block, about twice as long each round (641, 5,368, 10,769, ...).
title: What is known about 1RB0RE_0LC0RF_1LD1LC_1RA0LD_0RD1RE_---0LB
description: Proof status of the six-state BB(6) holdout 1RB0RE_0LC0RF_1LD1LC_1RA0LD_0RD1RE_---0LB.
intro: Nobody knows whether this six-state, two-symbol Turing machine halts when started on a blank tape: it is one of the holdouts left open by the bbchallenge project. This page lists what has been established about it, sorted by what each result rests on.
verdict: The question is open. The run is a sequence of phases on three long blocks; the two main phases are proved in Lean as one-cycle rules for every block size (kernel). The recycling between rounds and a small counter that appears in later rounds are known from simulation only.

claims.title: The halting configurations
claims.text: The machine stops exactly when it reads the symbol of a halting transition (F0); the generated statement covers every configuration.

claims.title: No halt in the first 10,000 steps
claims.text: The list simulator of the shared library, proved to agree with the machine's semantics, runs 10,000 steps from blank tape without a halt, evaluated by Lean's kernel.

claims.title: No halt in the first 10<sup>7</sup> steps
claims.text: The same run, evaluated by compiled code.

claims.title: No halt in the first 10<sup>9</sup> steps
claims.text: The C simulator tools/c/triage.c runs 109 steps without a halt; at the end 52,423 cells have been visited and 28,979 of them hold a 1.

claims.title: Growth shape: sqrt/sqrt
claims.text: Left of the start, the visited part of the tape grows like the square root of the step count, the signature of a head sweeping back and forth across the whole tape and adding a cell or a few at the end of each sweep (a bouncer-like shape) (fitted exponent 0.46). Right of the start it grows like the square root of the step count, the signature of a head sweeping back and forth across the whole tape and adding a cell or a few at the end of each sweep (a bouncer-like shape) (fitted exponent 0.615).

claims.title: Phase A, one visit
claims.text: 0^∞ D>0 0 1^5 (00111)^a (100)^(a+1) (10111)^(b+1) R reaches 0^∞ D>0 0 1^5 (00111)^(a+1) (100)^(a+2) (10111)^b R in 28a + 55 steps, for every a, b and every tape R further right.

claims.title: Phase B, two visits
claims.text: 0^∞ D>0 0 1^5 (00111)^a (100)^(c+4) (111100)^e 0 0^∞ reaches the same with a+2, c+2, e+1 in 32a + 24c + 50e + 178 steps.

claims.title: Rounds
claims.text: The left block is recycled into the next right block: 566 words at step 3.37·10<sup>6</sup>, 5,368 at 2.85·10<sup>8</sup>, 10,769 at 1.75·10<sup>9</sup>; in later rounds a small counter between the blocks slows phase B down.

claims.title: Does it halt from blank tape?
claims.text: Not known. Two phases are proved; the phase changes, and a small counter that drives the later rounds, are not.

explainer.lede: Nobody knows yet. Three long blocks on this machine's tape trade cells like the digits of a slow counter: at each visit of the left end one word moves from the right block to the left, then the middle block is poured to the far right, and the left block is recycled as the next right block, about twice as long.

facts.text: Phase A and phase B, proved in Lean for every block size.
No halt in the C simulator; 52,423 cells visited.
No halt, proved in Lean; the first 10,000 by the kernel alone.

sections.heading: The shape of the run
html: Left of the start, the visited part of the tape grows like the square root of the step count, the signature of a head sweeping back and forth across the whole tape and adding a cell or a few at the end of each sweep (a bouncer-like shape) (fitted exponent 0.46). Right of the start it grows like the square root of the step count, the signature of a head sweeping back and forth across the whole tape and adding a cell or a few at the end of each sweep (a bouncer-like shape) (fitted exponent 0.615).
After 109 steps the tape spans 52,423 cells (33,516 left of the start, 6,210 right), with a density of 1s of 0.553.
These are measurements of one bounded run, sorted by tools/py/bbtools/triage.py; the macro structure behind them is the next thing to find.

sections.heading: Three long blocks
html: Each time the head reaches the left end of the tape in state D, the tape reads
for instance at step 315,712,461: 0 0 1^5 (00111)^1475 (100)^1476 (10111)^3922 1 0 0 1^4 0 1^4 0 0 1 0. On the way right the words show up rotated (11001, 001, 01111).

sections.heading: Two phases and a recycling step
html:
phaseper visitstepsproof
A: (00111)^a (100)^(a+1) (10111)^ba+1, c+1, b−1: one word 10111 (5 cells) becomes 00111 + 100 (8 cells)28a + 55Lean grow
B: (00111)^a (100)^c (111100)^e 0per two visits a+2, c−2, e+132a + 24c + 50e + 178Lean pour

In phase A the head does not even reach the right part of the tape: it shuttles between the left end and the right block, and the tape grows only at the left. When the right block is empty, phase B pours the middle block into a new block at the far right, two words for one. When the middle block is empty the left block is rewritten as (01111)^a, which becomes the right block of the next phase A, and the cycle restarts with a and c near 0.

So each round the left block takes the size of the old right block plus what the round adds, and the run grows like a counter whose digits are block lengths: the recycled block had 566 words at step 3.37·106, 5,368 at 2.85·108 and 10,769 at 1.75·109. From then on the far-right block of the previous round stays on the tape, and phase B becomes slower: a small counter of short (001) and 1 1 1 pieces forms between the middle and right blocks and the far-right block is eaten a word per few visits.

The machine halts only on F reading a 0, and F is entered only from B reading a 1 (B writes a 0 and moves right). In the phases above the cell F then reads is always a 1 inside the words; a halt would need a phase change to put a 0 there.
